title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
abstract: arXiv:2610.32483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model

translated_title: 当智能体失败时：模型还是执行框架——该归咎于谁？
translated_abstract: LLM智能体将模型与执行框架相结合，因此智能体基准测试的性能反映了二者的共同行为。我们认为，因此应当通过执行框架与底层模型的交互来评估框架。我们开发了一个结合五种互补指标的评估框架：(i) 有效完成率（VCR），即智能体正常完成并交付可评估结果的可靠程度，与任务正确性无关；(ii) 模型-框架匹配度，即框架通过有效完成来支持给定模型达成任务的程度；(iii) 跨模型匹配度，即框架在被评估的各模型上的整体适用性；(iv) 交互残差，即被组件级汇总指标所掩盖的特定模型-框架配对的执行优势与劣势；以及 (v) Token负载，即智能体执行所消耗的token量，包括失败尝试。我们使用四个核心模型评估了四个通用执行框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI和DeepAgents），外加两个固定的原生模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一个通过五种互补指标（有效完成率、模型-框架匹配度、跨模型匹配度、交互残差和Token负载）来评估LLM智能体执行框架与底层模型交互表现的方法，用以区分智能体失败时究竟应归咎于模型还是执行框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an evaluation framework with five complementary metrics—Valid Completion Rate, Model-Harness Fit, Cross-Model Fit, Interaction Residuals, and Token Load—to assess LLM agent harnesses through their interactions with underlying models, helping attribute agent failures to either the model or the harness.
